added_comments.text: Lines are rounded individually (discount and tax per line) while the invoice total is rounded once on the order-level amounts, so the two can drift apart by several minor units as line count grows.
Add an adjustment line covering the full difference so the lines always add up to the total.

rationale: The agent removed the hardcoded ±0.01 clamp inside reconcileTotal (the actual bug hiding behind the 'float weirdness, don't touch' comment) and replaced it with the true, currency-aware computed difference, which fixes the whole class of drifts larger than one cent, not just the $0.02 example. It also switched buildInvoice's total calculation to the same currency-aware roundMoney helper, keeping JPY's whole-yen, half-up rounding policy intact rather than breaking it.
